rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-approved programs, including credits in ACPE-approved post-graduate degree programs (1 credit = 10 hours)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required for the biennium in which the license was first issued.
rules.notes: Reporting period June 1 of an even year to May 31 of the next even year; licenses renewed by May 31 of even years (late renewal $99 incl. $25 late fee). No mandatory topics listed by DSPS.
rules.rule_quote: Continuing Education Information 30 hours through ACPE.
